vaultScreen.title: Vault
vaultScreen.lead: Your pulls live here first — a private, premium hold where you trade in, list, or ship later. Traded-in hits stay in pull history only.
vaultScreen.benefit1: • Keep hits inside Pull Hub — build a real collection, not one-off shipments.
vaultScreen.benefit2: • Vault Exchange: friends see your whole Vault — request anything; only your listings get Buy now (card checkout).
vaultScreen.benefit3: • Request shipment on your schedule — fewer rushed labels, calmer fulfillment.
vaultScreen.benefit4: • Every secured item shows a clear Vault status so you always know the available next action.
vaultScreen.benefit5: • Trade in is always an explicit player action — the release app will not do it automatically.
vaultScreen.benefitFine: Preview timing is under product review. No automatic Trade in is approved for release.
vaultScreen.emptyBody: Open packs on Packs — new hits land here secured, insured-feeling, and ready for what you do next.
vaultScreen.guestTitle: Sign in to use your vault

wonPrizesModal.title: Trade in or Vault
wonPrizesModal.lead: By default every hit trades in for Points as soon as you confirm. Check any row to secure it in the Vault instead — list or ship later. Shipping starts from the Vault when you’re ready.
wonPrizesModal.summaryAllVault: Everything here is headed to your Vault with a {{days}}-day complimentary hold. No Points are added until you trade in from the Vault or the hold ends.
wonPrizesModal.summaryAllConvert: You’re trading in the full batch for Points — Points land as soon as you confirm.
wonPrizesModal.summaryMixed: Unchecked rows trade in for Points on confirm. Checked rows stay in your Vault for {{days}} days.
wonPrizesModal.checkboxHint: Default: trades in for Points when you confirm. Checked rows go to your Vault instead.
wonPrizesModal.footerVaultLine: Preview timer only · release behavior pending
wonPrizesModal.confirmBody: We’ll add Points immediately for every row being traded in. Vault rows stay secured.
wonPrizesModal.confirmVaultNote: The other {{count}} secured hits keep their {{days}}-day Vault hold.

credits.a: Points are the in-app currency used to open digital packs. Purchases in this preview may be simulated — final pricing, refunds, and bundles will be published before launch.

shipping.q: Where do you ship physical cards?
shipping.a: Marketplace orders ship from partner stores. Cutoffs, carriers, and fees vary by listing. Add a shipping address in Account so checkout is faster when payments go live.

drops.a: Hot drops are limited-time or high-demand pack releases. They are different from account promos (bonuses and coupons). Tap Hot Drops on Account for a short explainer.

hotDropsInfo.title: Release windows, made clear.
hotDropsInfo.body: Product concept preview. Hot drops are planned as limited release windows for selected packs; no live schedule is connected in this build.
hotDropsInfo.b1: Planned: show a start time, end time, and remaining availability.
hotDropsInfo.b2: Planned: link directly to the pack’s approved price and probability disclosure.
hotDropsInfo.b3: Planned: optional alerts after notification delivery is connected.

promosInfo.b2: Planned: make eligibility and stacking limits clear before activation.
promosInfo.b3: Planned: keep incentives separate from pack availability and probabilities.
promosInfo.vsHotBody: A hot drop would describe a limited pack release. A promo would describe an incentive governed by separate approved rules.

pullHistoryScreen.lead: Every completed play — newest first. Pending pulls stay in the pack flow until you trade in or ship.

linkedAccounts.body: Linking lets you sign in to the same Pull Hub profile with more than one method (for example Google and Apple), so you are not locked to a single login.
linkedAccounts.whatBody: It is not about merging two separate app accounts. It is about attaching sign-in providers to one account for convenience and recovery.
linkedAccounts.note: Provider linking will use your auth settings (e.g. Clerk) in production.

identityVerification.body: Identity verification may be required before selected marketplace, shipping, or payout features become available.
identityVerification.whyBody: Requirements vary by region and processor. Pull Hub will request only the checks required for the feature being used.
identityVerification.step3: Status and next steps from the selected provider
identityVerification.note: This build only explains the concept. No identity documents are collected in this preview.
